summary: Tested HR digital employee/academic card + photo approval flow (backend + frontend). Backend: 27/27 pytest tests passed covering my_card, admin card, photo upload (self + admin direct), one-chance rule, reject/approve, allow-upload, delete, pending list, admin photo image, public verify (valid/invalid), public photo, notifications, dean 403, regression on /hr/employees/me and /hr/employees/{id}. Frontend: /verify-employee?token=<valid> renders 'verify-employee-card' with 'verify-valid' + all employee rows and Arabic 'سارية' message. Bad token renders 'verify-invalid'. /hr-employees drawer for 'حسن صالح' shows 'hr-photo-panel' with 'hr-photo-approved', 'hr-photo-pending', 'hr-photo-approve', 'hr-photo-reject', 'hr-photo-verify-link' all present when a pending photo exists. Idempotent card_token verified. Notifications titled 'لم تُعتمد صورة بطاقتك' and 'تم اعتماد صورة بطاقتك' created correctly.

issues: Loading spinner shown while axios call in flight (~2s) — acceptable but a skeleton could improve UX.

critical_code_review_comments: hr_cards.py _store_photo reads full body before size check — should stream/limit; on 6MB test still returns 400 correctly but memory usage grows.
photo_url in card_payload requires base URL + get_verify_base — if that config is empty, photo_url will be null even when photo exists. Currently works via _req_base fallback.
seed_data_creation: None. Employee 6ab3ec880186d4c5e32749b0 left with NO photo (has_photo=false, pending_photo=false, can_upload_photo=true) as instructed.
